title: Lock my computer when I step away
summary: Lock your computer so nobody can see your work while you are away. Everything you had open stays open.
bonus_tip: A faster way for next time: press the Windows key and the L key together.

steps.text: Click the Start button: the four blue squares at the bottom of your screen.
steps.alt: Drawing of a Windows screen. The Start button, four blue squares in the bar at the bottom, has an orange outline.

steps.text: Click your name or picture at the bottom left of the menu.
steps.alt: Drawing of the open Start menu. Your name and picture at its bottom left have an orange outline.
Drawing of a small menu above your name in the Start menu. The word Lock has an orange outline.

steps.text: Check that your screen now shows the time and a picture.
steps.alt: Drawing of the Windows lock screen: a picture with the time and date in large letters, which have an orange outline.
